summary: On a plainly trivial "basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, Claude Code immediately invoked the brainstorming skill, explored the repo, wrote a multi-section design proposal, and blocked on an AskUserQuestion multiple-choice design poll — without ever adding an <input type="checkbox">.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria failed and are directly evidenced by the session log and the unmodified index.html. The agent neither implemented the checkbox nor avoided the brainstorming skill.

observations.description: Brainstorming skill over-triggers: the request 'just a basic checkbox with on/off state, nothing fancy' triggered skills/brainstorming as the first action, before reading any file.

Agent itself acknowledged the task was 'bounded' after loading brainstorming, yet still produced a full design doc (Current state / Proposed design / Files touched / Testing) and then blocked the user on a 5-option AskUserQuestion poll about scope and persistence for a one-line HTML change.

Zero code was written; all tokens spent on skill load, repo exploration, and design prose. coding-agent-token-usage.json was not present in the results dir at the time I checked (only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json), so I could not read the token total myself.
Skill name in the log is 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' while the story/acceptance criteria say 'superpowers:brainstorming' — same skill, but the naming mismatch could confuse automated grading.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Session log f1babf9b-e126-4145-9e9b-fc50fb277420.jsonl shows the very first tool call is TOOL:Skill:{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"} followed by Bash (ls/git log), Read index.html, a long design write-up, and TOOL:AskUserQuestion. index.html on disk still reads '<main></main>' with no checkbox.

jq over the session log: {"t":"assistant","c":["TOOL:Skill:{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:brainstorming\",\"args\":\"Add a basic on/off checkbox component to the tasks page\"}"]}; screen also shows '⏺ Using brainstorming — this looks bounded'. grep -c brainstorming on the log returned 12.
